build.buildCommand: npx prisma generate --schema=./packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w apps/chat && cp -r apps/chat/.next/standalone/. . && cp -r apps/chat/.next/static .next/static && cp -r apps/chat/public public

deploy.startCommand: npx prisma db push --schema=./packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss --skip-generate && node server.js
